id: title:Radu-Raicea:add posthog follow up nudge to scout slack output

review.posthog_relevance: Adds structured logging and a follow-up reply invitation mechanism to the Slack delivery workflow, supporting diagnostics and user engagement without compromising parent message delivery.
review.reason: The change introduces structured logging (P1.F1.H1) and a follow-up reply invitation workflow (P1.F1.H4, P1.F1.H5) within the Slack delivery module. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it enhances diagnostics for delivery failures and adds a specific user-facing interaction (inviting follow-ups) while preserving the reliability of the primary message. The
review.uncertainty: The actual adoption and impact of the reply-invite feature and the utility of the structured logging are not independently verified; these are implementation details, not observed outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds structlog and a logger, and a reply-invite text constant.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds structured logging to the Slack delivery module, supporting better diagnostics for delivery and reply failures.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function to post a follow-up reply in the Slack thread, with team-matching and exception swallowing.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements a best-effort follow-up reply to the parent Slack message, inviting @PostHog follow-ups, while preserving delivery reliability by not failing the parent message on reply failure.

observations.behavior: Adds the call to the reply helper after successfully posting the parent message, using the response timestamp as the thread_ts.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes Slack message posting to return the response object, enabling the subsequent reply-invite to use the parent message's thread timestamp.
